payload.title: Which hyp commit implements the record?
payload.body: The build question of G-BPWZ24. The run adds one Hypothesis per candidate commit on feat/record, with its subject the base plus that commit; a fix is a new Hypothesis that supersedes the one it fixes. The base is commit c5b34da (h-record-16 of G-SZCBXZ) and is the Hypothesis 'nothing changes': each Experiment's rubric asks for red on base and green on the candidate, except the lines the Goal body says hold on the base (lines 5 and 7), which are green on both. On the base, an import that lacks a named file, bundle or subject commit adds the event anyway and a store folder name with a character outside the plain set is accepted, so lines 6 and 8 separate a candidate from the base.

why: The grill's one build question for G-BPWZ24; the run adds its Hypotheses, one per commit.

payload.summary: Second grill of #181: Goal G-BPWZ24 with lines 1-10 and build question Q-RDPEBJ; base c5b34da (h-record-16 of G-SZCBXZ); the run continues on feat/record and PR #187 with aliases h-rec2-.
